verdict.rationale: Official SDKs are a fair axis for a SaaS control-plane platform, but the evidence pack never documents official client SDKs for Gram's own API. The pack documents a CLI, a platform MCP server and TypeScript Functions as tool sources, and none of these is an official SDK for building against the product. The OpenAPI probe also returned 404 on every candidate path, so there is no published API spec from which SDKs could be inferred.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
